name: pomegr-landing
description: The independently deployed public site and waitlist for Pomegr.

scripts.build:audit: npm run build && npm run audit:artifact
scripts.deploy: node scripts/assert-production-config.mjs && npm run audit:artifact && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.release: npm run build:audit && npm run deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply pomegr-waitlist --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply pomegr-waitlist --remote
